name: Deadeye imp
description: a small wiry hell imp of the Ember Wastes: crimson leathery skin, short curled black horns, leathery bat wings, a long whip tail with a spade tip, yellow eyes and a toothy grin, one eye screwed shut and a round shard of clear glass held over the other eye like a monocle, a thin white-hot bolt of fire balanced between two claws like a dart

poses.stand: hovering very still on slow wings, squinting along the white-hot dart held up by its cheek, aiming to the right
poses.struck: just hit and recoiling, eyes wide, mouth open, body jolted back, sparks and chips flying off it
poses.dead: breaking apart in a burst of black soot, grey ash and orange embers

idle.action: hovers very still, squinting through the glass monocle, adjusting its aim

attack.action: takes slow aim, then flicks the white-hot dart forward to the right in a straight line and lowers its arm

hurt.action: is struck, jerks backward with a pained grimace, then recovers

die.action: flares bright and breaks apart into soot, ash and embers
